findings.result: MCP production delegates to Service and Protocol; connect-store is dev-only. Review-loop production communicates through connect-client. Its application state is separate from authoritative Connect state.

Invocation admission runs inside the Store transaction before effect or receipt access. Task continuation revalidates the original backing credential, immutable conversation and operation/recipient ceilings. Provider effect dispatch reloads committed credential/grant links at last-mile admission.

Terminal task transitions revoke grants and cancel prepared effects atomically. Interrupted MCP work produces transport-uncertain with logical correlation and reconciliation guidance. No timeout is presented as completed work or permission to send again.

Shared MCP request/listener admission is 32 with immediate overload rather than an unbounded queue. Wait work retains time for authority recheck and response projection. Listener slots live with the accept task and shutdown observation survives panic/aborted startup.

Private bootstrap bearer verification precedes correlation parsing. A bounded assistant lookup preserves its saved model/tools; current task authority is checked again before staging. rvoip admission owns the final current authorization and one-dispatch boundary. Closed CallStage diagnostics avoid private causes in logs.

Renewal preserves exact task, binding and operations under the host lock. It retains original installation/session intent and cannot revive cancelled server authority. Diagnostic state uses bounded/private reads, a second sample and sanitized metadata; it does not attest model progress or delivery.

Historical fixtures inspect table/row preservation, real artifact bytes and receipts, old-binary schema refusal and matching-snapshot rollback. Interrupted snapshot uses a FIFO only in a disposable copy and refuses a missing manifest. Recovered tasks retain source/question/cursor state and recheck current cancellation before replay.

New Gate 4 MCP/host/bootstrap/runner responsibilities are split into focused modules, documented at crate/API boundaries and under unsafe_code=forbid. Public communication examples exercise the client. Existing largest cross-gate source files are recorded below; this review found no blocking need for an arbitrary line-count split.

Archive extraction restricts regular files/directories and rejects traversal, mutable private state and checkout/build directories. Runtime and exact-source fault controls are separate. Initial executable launch is recorded separately while existing request/task/recovery deadlines remain in force.
